section.title: FactorProduct — solve by factoring
section.blurb: Same ladder as old factor_poly: D=0 is monic $x^2+7x+12=0$; D≥8 is a≠1 (ac method); D>10 unsimplifies. Always degree 2 — not grouping. Opt out with use_factor_poly=True.
